operation_details.item: The user briefs the board through a dedicated Slack channel between formal meetings.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the board communication rhythm looking this month?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty steady. We still send the monthly performance pack by email and hold the in-person briefing each quarter.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: And do you keep them updated between those formal touchpoints?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes. We brief the board through a dedicated Slack channel between formal meetings.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That’s a useful complement to the formal cadence. Is the channel mainly for quick updates or broader discussion?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Mostly concise updates and questions that don’t need to wait for the next meeting.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. Do you also continue sharing audit summaries with the finance committee?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, that remains part of the regular process.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only that we use a Slack channel for board briefings, but retain the email pack, quarterly in-person briefing, and audit summaries.
